reports.typeOfIncident: Wall glass panel at office space cracked
reports.asset: Office space shattered, left wall glass panel
reports.incidentDescription: On 26 October 2026 at 7:43 AM, Executive Safety (Noor Aini) pass the information regarding wall glass panel at office space shattered via WhatsApp (include picture) and forwarded to the Facilities Engineer (Haronizan) for further action.
reports.employeeStatement: On 26 October 2026 at 6:54 AM, I as a cleaner entered the office to perform routine daily cleaning duties. While carrying out the cleaning activities, the cleaner noticed that a glass panel was cracked and immediately reported the issue to Executive Safety (Noor Aini) via Whatsapp immediately.
reports.ioAction:
Based on CCTV footage dated 26/10/2026, 01:52 AM, sudden shaking occurred at the location. As a result, the left wall glass panel cracked from top to bottom but did not shatter. No injuries were reported, as there were no employees or staff at location. 

Several CCTV reviews were conducted on Levels 1 and 2 during the same time period; however, no activities were observed that could have caused the incident. The Security Team provided the relevant CCTV footage to the Facilities Department, and further investigation into the root cause of the incident has been handed over to the Facilities team.

From the security perspective, recommendations from the Safety may be sought if deemed necessary. Any repair or replacement costs will be subject to management's review and approval.

reports.incidentDescription: On 17/10/2026, at approximately 4:34 am, PT driver Md Sohag Hossen from the Replenishment Department hit a pilar on the WT Food Zone side with a pallet while moving goods, causing damage to the pillar.
reports.employeeStatement: Md Sohag Hossen from the Replenishment Department, Passport No. A06389029, lineally denied responsibility for the pillar damaged. After the Security Officer showed me the CCTV footage and further discussion, I acknowledge my mistake and apologized. I promise to be more careful and ensure the incident does not happen again.
reports.ioAction: In relation to this case the matter is handed over to management to make the appropriate decision regarding the employee. The cost of repair will be charged to the agency.

reports.typeOfIncident: A truck driver was involved in an accident
reports.locationOfIncident: KM16, Lebuhraya Persekutuan (Federal Highway), from Kuala Lumpur
reports.incidentDescription: On 11 October 2026, at approximately 0430am, driver Ahmad Alf Iqwan bin Mohd Azizi (NRIC:990520-03-5991), who was driving truck VPG 4910, was involved in an accident at KM 16 of the Federal Highway (Lebuhraya Persekutuan), on the left land heading from Kuala Lumpur towards Klang. According to the driver's statement, an unidentified car hit the right side of the truck and then left the scene without stopping. The right side of the truck sustained damage. The driver was unable to identify the car's registration number. The driver lodges a police report at Shah Alam Traffic Police Station at approximately 12:00 am on 12 October 2026.
reports.refName: Ahmad Alif Iqwan bin Mohd Azizi
reports.ioAction: Regarding this case, the matter has been handed over to management to make the appropriate decision regarding the employee. The repair cost will be charged accordingly.
reports.complainantName: Ahmad Alf Iqwan bin Mohd Azizi

reports.typeOfIncident: Disruption of Security Operations / Worker Conduct
reports.incidentDescription: Regarding a personal matter involving a worker resulted in the girl's parents coming to the company premises and causing a disturbance at the main guard post. Their actions disrupted the guard's registration duties and normal security operations. The Police subsequently attended the premises to address the matter, which may have negatively affected the company's image and reputation.
reports.employeeStatement:
I, Mukesh Kumar, acknowledge that my personal matter resulted in the girl's parents coming to the company premises and causing a disturbance at the main guard post. As a result, the security guard was unable to carry out his registration and security duties properly, causing disruption to normal security operations.

I acknowledge that I should have handled the matter more appropriately and ensured that my personal issues did not affect the company's operations or involve external parties at the workplace. I sincerely apologize for the inconvenience and disruption caused and promise to exercise greater responsibility and ensure that such an incident does not happen again.
reports.ioAction: Security Officer attended the main guard post and spoke with the girl's parents and the Police regarding the issue. The situation was handled calmly and resolved politely without any further disturbance or major problems. In relation to this case, the matter is handed over to management to make the appropriate decision regarding the employee.

reports.typeOfIncident: Driver Damage to Neighboring Signboard at Store #0404
reports.locationOfIncident: 8 Jalan 7/108c, Taman Sg Besi, 57100 Kuala Lumpur
reports.incidentDescription: The incident occurred at 7E Store #0404 on the date of the event. An early report was initiated by Field Manager (FM) Nurul Baiti binti Kamarulzaman, who stated that a SALS driver (Plate No: VPH 7260) collided with the neighboring signboard of Health Lane Family Pharmacy during a delivery operation. According to the reporter, the driver failed to disclose or report the incident for nearly three months, resulting in delayed corrective action and accountability.
reports.ioAction: Verbal information was obtained from Field Manager (FM) Nurul Baiti binti Kamarulzaman via a telephone call on 17 September 2026 at 2:34 PM. An internal investigation was subsequently conducted with the driver on 18 September 2026 at 10:00 AM to gather details and to address the negligence of failing to promptly report the incident to superiors. During the investigation, the driver was informed that this constituted his third recorded negligence, and a stern warning was issued to ensure such misconduct does not recur. The investigation evidence and findings were then submitted to management for further action.

reports.incidentDescription: The driver (Muhammad Azli bin Mat Ariffin) was called to bring the truck to the loading bay for loading. After adjusting the tailgate, the driver failed to secure the controller back inside the truck. While moving the truck from the parking lot to the loading bay, the controller was dragged along the ground, resulting in severe damage. The control pendant is completely damaged and unusable, and the wiring harness has been damaged.
reports.employeeStatement:
I, Muhammad Azli bin Mat Ariffin truck driver for VPH7260, admit that due to my negligence and carelessness, I failed to secure the controller after adjusting the tailgate. As a result, the controller was dragged along the ground while moving the truck, causing severe damage to the control pendant and wiring harness.

I acknowledge this mistake was entirely my responsibility. I sincerely apologize for the incident and promise to exercise greater care in the future to ensure such negligence does not occur again.
reports.ioAction: In relation to this case, the matter is handed over to management to make the appropriate decision regarding the employee.
